note: The original describes the alate and the soldier, each with a table of measurements; the body size and the shape of the nota of the soldier vary markedly among populations, and the original separates the values for the holotype and for the two series of paratypes from Palawan and Pohnpei.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text:
The alate differs from that of G. lighti in the shape of the eyes, the narrower and shorter wings and the less bluntly rounded posterolateral corners of the pronotum; compared with G. taveuniensis the head is broader, the eyes larger and of a different shape, and the wings longer and broader. The soldier is close to that of Glyptotermes nissanensis, from which it differs in the gentler slope of the frons and the pointed middle of the anterior margin of the labrum; compared with G. lighti the slope of the frons is gentler, the posterior margin of the head is concave in the middle and the anterior margin of the pronotum is more deeply concave. Both the body size of the soldier and the shape of the pronotum vary markedly.

The type locality is a small bay on the south side of a limestone ridge on Koror Island, Palau (7°20′ N, 134°30′ E), collected from palm wood; paratypes were also collected on Babeldaob, Olapsuchelkal Island, Kayangel Atoll and Peleliu, and on Pohnpei, Caroline Islands (at about 500—1000 feet and about 2000 feet), from rotten wood and under bark of palms, coconut palms and figs.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head rusty brown; pronotum dark rusty brown, darker than the head; labrum brownish yellow; antennae smoky brown; femora brown; tibiae nearly white; nota brown; wings smoky brown, the wing scales paler than the pronotum. Head and pronotum with sparse, erect setae, the margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head with a Y-suture, but it is indistinct. Eyes small, shaped as figured. Ocelli oval, touching the eyes. Antennae 11—12-segmented, segments 2 and 3 nearly equal in length, segment 3 longer than segment 4. Pronotum narrower than the head, anterior margin concave, sides converging forwards into a straight posterior margin (as in the original). The media of the hindwing arises from the radial sector beyond the wing scale, about 0.98 mm from the wing suture.

Alate measurements (Palau holotype nest and paratype nests, n=20; Pohnpei paratype nest, n=4): head length (to the tip of the labrum) 0.98—1.20 mm (n=20), 1.05—1.13 mm (n=4); head length (to the base of the mandibles) 0.83—0.90 mm, 0.83—0.90 mm; head width 0.84—0.98 mm, 0.86—0.92 mm; eye diameter 0.25—0.29 mm, 0.25—0.29 mm; distance from the lower margin of the eye 0.09—0.13 mm, 0.09—0.11 mm; ocellus length 0.07—0.09 mm, 0.07 mm; pronotum median length 0.41—0.53 mm, 0.45—0.49 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.50—0.60 mm, 0.53—0.56 mm; pronotum width 0.68—0.88 mm, 0.73—0.86 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.68—0.83 mm, 0.68—0.75 mm; forewing length from the suture 4.05—5.29 mm; forewing width 1.07—1.35 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head brownish yellow, paler posteriorly, somewhat darker in the frontal region; labrum pale yellow; mandibles pale reddish brown at the base, nearly black at the apex; antennae pale brownish yellow; pronotum brownish yellow; nota and legs pale brownish yellow. Head and pronotum with sparse, erect setae, the margins and disc of the pronotum with both long and short setae. Head variable in size, sides parallel; anterodorsal projection indistinct; frons slightly concave in the middle; frontal face forming a slope of about 50° in lateral view. Y-suture present but indistinct. Eyes small, oval. Anterior margin of the labrum pointed in the middle. Mandibles short, outer margin evenly curved; left mandible with 3 marginal teeth, the first and second close together, the posterior margin of the second tooth and the anterior margin of the third forming a concave cutting edge; right mandible with 2 marginal teeth, the second reduced; the tip of the first marginal tooth lies 0.34 mm from the tip of the apical tooth. Postmentum long, anterior margin straight, narrowest at the posterior third, the sides converging forwards from the widest point. Antennae 9—11-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 4, segment 3 variable. Pronotum as wide as the head or wider, variable in shape and size; anterior margin deeply concave, anterolateral corners broad and rounded; posterolateral margins concave or wavy in specimens from the type nest, concave or broadly rounded in paratype-nest specimens; posterior margin slightly incurved in the middle. Hind femora slightly inflated.

Soldier measurements (holotype; Palau paratype nests n=20; Pohnpei paratype nests n=5): head length (to the base of the mandibles) 1.88 mm, 1.20—1.95 mm, 1.28—1.73 mm; head width 1.09 mm, 0.83—1.13 mm, 0.90—1.05 mm; head height 1.01 mm, 0.75—1.05 mm, 0.83—0.94 mm; length of the left mandible 0.75 mm, 0.60—0.79 mm, 0.60—0.73 mm; postmentum maximum width 0.43 mm, 0.32—0.45 mm, 0.32—0.38 mm; postmentum minimum width 0.21 mm, 0.15—0.23 mm, 0.15—0.17 mm; postmentum length 1.35 mm, 0.75—1.43 mm, 0.75—1.20 mm; pronotum median length 0.60 mm, 0.34—0.68 mm, 0.34—0.53 mm; pronotum maximum length 0.83 mm, 0.45—0.86 mm, 0.45—0.68 mm; pronotum width 1.13 mm, 0.75—1.20 mm, 0.75—0.98 mm; length of the hind tibia 0.83 mm, 0.49—0.84 mm, 0.56—0.75 mm.
